name: HONOR
summary: HONOR is a Shenzhen-based device company whose portfolio spans phones, computers, tablets and wearables. It has expanded into embodied AI and humanoid robotics, presenting the HONOR Robotics D1 and A1 at the 2026 Beijing E-Town humanoid robot half-marathon. Its D1 platform emphasizes dynamic bipedal movement, autonomous perception and navigation. The company markets robotics alongside its broader AI device ecosystem.
